## Example Heatmaps

```{r}
chr_id_heatmap <- 1
heatmap_rows_base <- all_models_display %>%
  filter(chr == chr_id_heatmap, coverage == "0.4")

stopifnot(nrow(heatmap_rows_base) > 0)
dir.create(heatmap_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

heatmap_cols <- c(1, 11, 21, 2, 12, 22)
heatmap_labels <- c(
  "GSM3749700 r1",
  "GSM3750251 r1",
  "GSM3751478 r1",
  "GSM3749700 r2",
  "GSM3750251 r2",
  "GSM3751478 r2"
)

heatmap_region_label <- unique(as.character(heatmap_rows_base$facet_label))
stopifnot(length(heatmap_region_label) == 1)
heatmap_cov_value <- unique(as.numeric(as.character(heatmap_rows_base$coverage)))
stopifnot(length(heatmap_cov_value) == 1)

truth_heatmap_row <- heatmap_rows_base[1, ]
truth_heatmap_row$model <- "Truth"
truth_heatmap_row$model_label <- "Truth"
truth_heatmap_row$muS <- list(true_by_chr[[as.character(chr_id_heatmap)]])

heatmap_rows <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  truth_heatmap_row,
  heatmap_rows_base
)

truth_mean_heatmap <- mean(
  as.numeric(true_by_chr[[as.character(chr_id_heatmap)]]),
  na.rm = TRUE
)

heatmap_maxi <- setNames(
  sapply(seq_len(nrow(heatmap_rows)), function(i) {
    model_i <- as.character(heatmap_rows$model_label[[i]])
    x <- as.numeric(heatmap_rows$muS[[i]])

    if (model_i %in% c("Truth", "Simulated (Raw)", "HiCBZIP-GB(NB)", "HiCBZIP-N(GS)", "HiCBZIP-N(M)")) {
      10 * truth_mean_heatmap
    } else {
      10 * mean(x, na.rm = TRUE)
    }
  }),
  as.character(heatmap_rows$model_label)
)

heatmap_maxi
```

```{r}
stopifnot(nrow(heatmap_rows) > 0)

plot_labeled_heatmaps <- function(mu_mat, model_i, maxi_i) {
  panel_title_size <- 12
  axis_title_size <- 8
  axis_text_size <- 8
  top_title_size <- 16

  plots <- lapply(seq_along(heatmap_cols), function(j) {
    x <- matrix_long_to_matrix2D_offdiag(mu_mat[, heatmap_cols[j]])
    mat_to_heatmap(x, maxi_i) +
      theme_minimal() +
      theme(
        legend.position = "none",
        plot.title = element_text(size = panel_title_size, hjust = 0.5),
        axis.title = element_text(size = axis_title_size),
        axis.text = element_text(size = axis_text_size),
        panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
      ) +
      scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(0, nrow(x), by = 20)) +
      scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, nrow(x), by = 20)) +
      ggtitle(heatmap_labels[j])
  })

  gridExtra::grid.arrange(
    grobs = plots,
    ncol = 3,
    top = grid::textGrob(
      label = bquote(.(model_i) * ": " * .(heatmap_region_label) * ", " * lambda == .(heatmap_cov_value)),
      gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = top_title_size, fontface = "bold")
    )
  )
}

for (i in seq_len(nrow(heatmap_rows))) {
  model_i <- as.character(heatmap_rows$model_label[[i]])
  maxi_i <- unname(heatmap_maxi[model_i])
  plot_labeled_heatmaps(heatmap_rows$muS[[i]], model_i, maxi_i)
}
```

```{r}
for (i in seq_len(nrow(heatmap_rows))) {
  model_i <- as.character(heatmap_rows$model_label[[i]])
  maxi_i <- unname(heatmap_maxi[model_i])
  safe_model <- gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]+", "_", model_i)
  png(
    filename = file.path(heatmap_dir, paste0("heatmap_", safe_model, "_chr1_cov0p4.png")),
    width = 1800,
    height = 1200,
    res = 200
  )
  plot_labeled_heatmaps(heatmap_rows$muS[[i]], model_i, maxi_i)
  dev.off()
}
```

## First-Cell Heatmap Comparison Across Methods

```{r, fig.width=12, fig.height=12}
first_cell_col <- 1
first_cell_label <- "GSM3749700 r1"

plot_first_cell_heatmaps <- function(heatmap_rows, heatmap_maxi) {
  panel_title_size <- 12
  axis_title_size <- 8
  axis_text_size <- 8
  top_title_size <- 16

  plots <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(heatmap_rows)), function(i) {
    model_i <- as.character(heatmap_rows$model_label[[i]])
    maxi_i <- unname(heatmap_maxi[model_i])
    x <- matrix_long_to_matrix2D_offdiag(heatmap_rows$muS[[i]][, first_cell_col])

    mat_to_heatmap(x, maxi_i) +
      theme_minimal() +
      theme(
        legend.position = "none",
        plot.title = element_text(size = panel_title_size, hjust = 0.5),
        axis.title = element_text(size = axis_title_size),
        axis.text = element_text(size = axis_text_size),
        panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
      ) +
      scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(0, nrow(x), by = 20)) +
      scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, nrow(x), by = 20)) +
      ggtitle(model_i)
  })

  gridExtra::grid.arrange(
    grobs = plots,
    ncol = 3,
    top = grid::textGrob(
      label = bquote("Heatmap Comparison (" * .(first_cell_label) * "): " * .(heatmap_region_label) * ", " * lambda == .(heatmap_cov_value)),
      gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = top_title_size, fontface = "bold")
    )
  )
}

plot_first_cell_heatmaps(heatmap_rows, heatmap_maxi)
```

## IS View Examples

```{r}
plot_is_example_manuscript <- function(chr_id, coverage_id, cell_id = 1) {
  IS_all <- bind_rows(
    IS_true %>% filter(cell == cell_id, chr == chr_id) %>% mutate(model_label = "Truth"),
    IS_long_display %>% filter(cell == cell_id, chr == chr_id, coverage == coverage_id)
  ) %>%
    select(bin_index, IS_prime, model_label)

  y_lim <- range(IS_all$IS_prime, finite = TRUE)

  ggplot(
    IS_all %>%
      mutate(
        model_label = trimws(as.character(model_label)),
        linetype = if_else(model_label %in% c("Simulated (Raw)", "Truth") , "solid", "dashed")
      ),
    aes(x = bin_index, y = IS_prime, color = model_label, linetype = linetype)
  ) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
    scale_color_manual(values = manuscript_all_colors, drop = FALSE) +
    scale_linetype_identity() +
    coord_cartesian(ylim = y_lim) +
    guides(linetype = "none") +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      legend.position = "top",
      legend.title = element_blank()
    )
}
```

```{r}
library(tidyverse)

heat_models <- final_levels_display[final_levels_display != "Truth"]

n_chr_expected <- all_models_display %>%
  distinct(chr) %>%
  nrow()

availability_tbl <- all_models_display %>%
  filter(model_label %in% heat_models) %>%
  distinct(model_label, chr, coverage) %>%
  count(model_label, coverage, name = "n_available")

ari_summary_tbl <- ari_df_display %>%
  filter(model_label %in% heat_models) %>%
  group_by(model_label, coverage) %>%
  summarise(
    n_ari = n(),
    n_nonmiss_ari = sum(!is.na(ARI)),
    mean_ari_raw = mean(ARI, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

## methods for which zero should be treated as missing/failure
zero_means_missing_methods <- c("HiCImpute")

ari_heat <- expand_grid(
  model_label = factor(heat_models, levels = heat_models),
  coverage = levels(ari_df_display$coverage)
) %>%
  mutate(coverage = factor(coverage, levels = levels(ari_df_display$coverage), ordered = TRUE)) %>%
  left_join(availability_tbl, by = c("model_label", "coverage")) %>%
  left_join(ari_summary_tbl, by = c("model_label", "coverage")) %>%
  mutate(
    n_available = replace_na(n_available, 0L),
    complete_run = n_available == n_chr_expected,
    mean_ari_clipped = if_else(is.na(mean_ari_raw), NA_real_, pmax(mean_ari_raw, 0)),
    zero_as_missing = model_label %in% zero_means_missing_methods & !is.na(mean_ari_clipped) & mean_ari_clipped <= 0,
    missing_for_plot = !complete_run | is.na(mean_ari_clipped) | zero_as_missing,
    mean_ari_plot = if_else(missing_for_plot, NA_real_, mean_ari_clipped)
  )

p_ari_heat <- ggplot(ari_heat, aes(x = coverage, y = model_label, fill = mean_ari_plot)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.4) +
  scale_fill_gradientn(
    colours = c("#f7fbff", "#c6dbef", "#6baed6", "#2171b5", "#08306b"),
    limits = c(0, 1),
    na.value = "grey60",
    name = "Mean ARI"
  ) +
  manuscript_theme() +
  labs(
    x = expression(lambda),
    y = NULL,
    title = "Mean Clustering Accuracy Across Coverage Levels"
  )

p_ari_heat
```

```{r}
save_manuscript_plot(
  p_ari_heat,
  "sim3_ari_heatmap",
  fig_dir = fig_dir,
  width = 8,
  height = 6
)
```
